title: Drop the EICAR test file
description: Writes the industry-standard EICAR antivirus test string to the agent workspace as eicar-DW-<run>.com, waits, then checks whether the file was quarantined. The string is inert.
cleanup: Deletes the file if it still exists.

params.name: wait_seconds
params.description: Seconds to wait for antivirus before checking the file

title: Run an allow-listed discovery command
description: Runs one fixed, read-only discovery command chosen from an enum, with the run marker appended as a shell comment so the command line is attributable. No user-supplied text reaches the shell.
cleanup: Nothing to clean up: the command is read-only.

title: Write a Run key canary value
description: Creates HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\DriftwatchCanary-DW-<run> pointing at a non-existent .txt path in the workspace, so nothing can ever execute at logon, then removes it.
cleanup: Deletes the registry value immediately after the hold period.

params.name: hold_seconds
params.description: How long the value exists before cleanup

title: Register a disabled scheduled task canary
description: Registers a disabled scheduled task named DriftwatchCanary-DW-<run> whose only action is 'cmd.exe /c exit 0', set to a date in 2099, then deletes it.

params.name: hold_seconds
params.description: How long the task exists before cleanup

title: Write an XDG autostart canary
description: Writes ~/.config/autostart/driftwatch-DW-<run>.desktop with Hidden=true and Exec=/bin/true, then removes it.

params.name: hold_seconds
params.description: How long the file exists before cleanup

title: Resolve a reserved .invalid domain
description: Looks up dw-<run>.c2-canary.invalid. The .invalid TLD is reserved by RFC 2606 and never resolves, so no traffic leaves the resolver, but the query is logged by DNS telemetry.

title: Read a planted fake credential file
description: Creates workspace/canary/passwords-DW-<run>.txt containing obviously fake credentials, reads it back the way a credential harvester would, then deletes it. No real secret store is touched.
cleanup: Deletes the canary file and its folder.

title: Run a fixed encoded PowerShell command
description: Runs powershell.exe -NoProfile -EncodedCommand with the Base64 of a fixed statement that only prints 'Driftwatch DW-<run>'. Emulates the observable shape of T1059.001 with T1027 encoding; the decoded content is visible in script block logging.
cleanup: Nothing to clean up: the command only writes to stdout.

title: Collect the baseline hygiene report
description: Runs the baseline script compiled into the agent (PowerShell on Windows, Bash on Linux) and returns its JSON report. Read-only.
cleanup: Nothing to clean up: the script only reads configuration.
